mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (y/y), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction term's Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0%), the risk of monetary tightening increases, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0% during late-cycle regimes, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising (y/y), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 (index, 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market expansion regimes characterized by rising housing starts (HOUST > 12-month moving average), the positive spillover to consumer confidence and construction sector earnings drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 12mo avg during housing market expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high real interest rate (FEDFUNDS minus CPIAUCSL above 2.0%) signals an aggressive monetary policy stance that suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
